data.title: Serie A official line-ups and live updates: Monza vs. Cagliari - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Dany Mota and Foe Ondoa come into the Monza side, while Cagliari pair M'Bala Nzola with Paul Mendy up front for their trip to the U-Power Stadium. Ivan Juric's Monza have just four points from their first six games after their return to Serie A, with one win, one draw and four defeats. They lost 3-1 at Lazio last time out, and have conceded 15 goals, the second-worst defensive record in the division. Cagliari are one of the surprise packages of the season, with 13 points from six games, and are unbeaten in four. They held Juventus to a 1-1 draw last time out, but Fabio Pisacane is suspended after his touchline row with Luciano Spalletti, so assistant Giacomo Murelli takes his place on the bench. Juric has a strong record against the Sardinians, losing just one of his last nine Serie A meetings with them, with four wins and four draws.
